course.method: closed-loop first-order trajectory least squares: course' = remainder(heading_setpoint - course, 2*pi)/tau, exact zero-order-hold discretization, DC gain structurally 1

limits: Measured velocity-input profile; no route-input qualification or general vessel certification.
provenance: Constants borrowed from the baseline (PID) lane measured on byte-identical guidance to seed planner own-ship models. The MPC controller lane has no closed-loop measurement of its own yet; trajectory_r_squared evidence fields are intentionally removed so the computed verdict is honest.

speed.method: closed-loop first-order trajectory least squares: speed' = (gain*speed_setpoint - speed)/tau, exact zero-order-hold discretization, active window = last nonzero command + 60 s settle
